# no-parens-around-if (IDM001)

| Category | Severity | Enabled by default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idiom | warning | no |

Checks that the conditions of an `if` statement have no parenthesis.

## Non-compliant example

```vhdl
if (condition) then
    foo <= bar;
end if;
```

## Compliant example

```vhdl
if condition then
    foo <= bar;
end if;
```

## Configuration

This rule is disabled by default. To enable it, add it to `select` in `vhdl-lint.toml`:

```toml
select = ["IDM001"]
```

or pass `--select IDM001` on the command line.
